_comment: E2E suite layout, read by the `changes` job of e2e_tests.yml.
tier 'fast' runs on every pull request that needs the suite; tier 'full' runs only on pushes to main, the nightly schedule and a dispatch with full=true.
Each entry is one job. Keep a fast job under about 12 minutes warm; timings in the notes are warm minutes from #475.
Job names are the check names; renaming one changes the check.
